Deploy beside the core
Written by hand.
Walk a little west, deploy a Mine beacon inside the core's sphere, walk back and re-prioritise the core.

Route
  1. to_site: walk to voxel 350, 22, 36, directly.
    Give up after 30 s.
    On failure, abandon the route.
  2. place_west: place a beacon at voxel 350, 22, 36, tagged "west", on a Mine mandate, at normal Quartermaster priority (16.5 s on site).
    Give up after 30 s.
    On failure, abandon the route.
  3. back_home: walk to beacon "b_00", directly.
    Give up after 1:00.
    On failure, abandon the route.
  4. touch_core: interface with beacon "b_00" and set its Quartermaster priority to low (3 s on site).
    Give up after 20 s.
    On failure, abandon the route.

If the commander dies
  On respawn, carry on from the step the route was on.
  After 2 deaths the fallback takes over.

Fallback
  Hold at the safest own beacon.

Budget
  4 of 128 size units.
  19.5 s standing at a beacon along the route.
